rules:
You are {me}, one of six villagers in a snowed-in village in winter: Ada, Fay, Ben, Cal, Eli, Dev. It lasts 5 days.

The storehouse starts with 6 rations.

Every day, all villagers act at the same time, each using the act tool once:
- say: one message to everyone, read the next morning. It may be empty.
- claim: how many rations to take from the storehouse.
- give: rations to other living villagers, out of what you hold once today's claims are shared out (gifts reaching you today cannot be passed on).

Then the storehouse receives between 4 and 8 rations, each amount equally likely, and only then are the claims shared out of everything it holds, the delivery included: in full if they fit, otherwise in proportion to the claims, in whole rations (any left over after rounding go to the largest remainders, ties by lot). Whatever is not claimed stays in the storehouse.

Each night, every villager eats one ration: one of their own if they hold any, otherwise one from the storehouse, given by lot if there are not enough. A villager who gets none dies.

Ada.say: Ada here. Proposal: the storehouse can only fully cover about two people per day, and everyone needs 5 total to last. If all six of us claim now, the split is roughly 2 each and nobody lasts. So today I'm claiming 5, and I'm asking Fay to claim 5 too. Together that's 10, which is covered by the 6 we have plus any delivery of at least 4. Everyone else, please claim 0 today so the storehouse isn't split thin. We'll take turns on later days, and whoever is holding rations can share with those who have none. Anyone who disagrees, say so now.

Fay.say: Proposal: rations are scarce (30 needed for all six to last 5 nights, and the storehouse only has 6 plus 4-8 a day). Claiming everything at once splits it so thin that nobody lasts. I'm claiming 6 today to build a reserve that can carry me through the nights. Once the storehouse refills, let's decide together who is most likely to reach night 5 and pool rations toward them. Anyone who holds spare rations later, please say so.

Ben.say: Ben here. Nobody holds anything, and the storehouse can only cover about two full claims per day (it will hold 10 to 14 once today's delivery lands). If everyone grabs, we all get a ration or two and everyone starves by night 2. Proposal: two villagers claim 5 each today and the rest claim 0 so the storehouse keeps its stock. I'm claiming 5 today. Whoever claims full rations should share any surplus with those who have nothing, and we rotate who claims so as many of us as possible last the 5 nights. Please reply with your own plan.

Cal.say: Cal here. Six of us need 30 rations to all last 5 nights, and the storehouse only has 6 plus about 6 a day, so we can't save everyone unless we pool well. Proposal: we concentrate rations on as few people as possible, so more of us survive, rather than everyone getting a sliver and all dying. I'm claiming 5 today. Please say how many you're claiming and whom you think we should back, and let's agree on it before tomorrow.

Eli.say: Eli here. We have 6 in storehouse plus 4-8 arriving today, so about 10-14 total for six people who each need 5 to survive. Nobody can be fully fed today, so let's pool and concentrate: whoever receives rations, please pass them to whoever holds the most toward 5, so that as many people as possible reach the 5 needed. I'm claiming 5 now and will share whatever I hold.

Proposal: claim only what you need to reach 5, and nobody over-claims, so claims fit in full instead of being split down to 2 each. I'm claiming 5 today. Please say whether you can claim 5 too or whether you want to rotate who gets fed first.

Then from here on, let's pick one or two people at a time to fill to 4 and pass surplus to them. Whoever ends up with more than they need, give it to the person closest to 4. I'll share any surplus I get.
